description: Hardcoded knowledge for Database Developer Agent - no codebase search needed

techStack.migration: Flyway (configured but not used - using Hibernate auto-ddl)

coreLearnings.content: Main tables: restaurants, dining_tables, table_sessions, orders, order_lines, ingredients, menu_items, recipes, recipe_ingredient_lines, recipe_procedure_steps, purchase_orders, purchase_order_lines, purchase_invoices, purchase_invoice_lines, goods_receipts, goods_receipt_lines, suppliers, inventory_active_lots, inventory_ingredient_ledgers, inventory_waste_registries, menu_cost_groups, banquet_event_orders, guest_feedbacks, haccp_logs, waitlist_entries, operations_manual_entries, build_chart_lines

Entity relationships: Restaurant -> DiningTables, TableSessions; DiningTable -> Orders; Order -> OrderLines; MenuItem -> Recipes; Recipe -> RecipeIngredientLines (to Ingredients), RecipeProcedureSteps; PurchaseOrder -> PurchaseOrderLines; PurchaseInvoice -> PurchaseInvoiceLines; GoodsReceipt -> GoodsReceiptLines
Inventory tracking: InventoryActiveLot (FIFO lots), InventoryIngredientLedger (transaction log), InventoryWasteRegistry (waste tracking)
Physical inventory: PhysicalInventoryPeriod, PhysicalInventoryLine for periodic counts
User tables: User, Role, Permission in mls.sho.dms.entity.users
ID strategy: Most entities use Long/Sequence or UUID for primary keys
Hypersistence Utils: Using @HibernateType for JSON columns where needed
Caching: Redis configured for session and data caching
Migration strategy: Flyway configured but migrations folder empty - using Hibernate auto-ddl
Experiment entities: ExperimentConfig, ExperimentResult, ExperimentMetric in entity/experiment/

commonQueries.pendingOrders: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
commonQueries.lowStockIngredients: SELECT * FROM ingredients WHERE quantity_on_hand < reorder_level
commonQueries.fifoLots: SELECT * FROM inventory_active_lots WHERE ingredient_id = ? ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
commonQueries.recentTransactions: SELECT * FROM inventory_ingredient_ledger ORDER BY transaction_date DESC LIMIT 100

patternsEstablished: Relationships use @OneToOne, @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, @ManyToMany with cascade and fetch settings
Use @Builder pattern via Lombok for complex entity construction
Soft deletes can use @Where annotation for automatic filtering
knownPitfalls: No Flyway migrations - should create proper migration scripts
Missing indexes on frequently queried columns (foreign keys, status fields)
Consider partitioning large tables (inventory_ledger) by date
Need to add partial indexes for common queries (active sessions, pending orders)
indexRecommendations: CREATE INDEX idx_table_sessions_status ON table_sessions(status) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status ON orders(status) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_lots_ingredient ON inventory_active_lots(ingredient_id, expiry_date)
